answer: SPDZ-style authenticated MPC attaches message authentication codes to every secret share, so any party that tampers with a share during the identity check is detected immediately and the computation aborts. Shares move through the protocol like a trellis guiding vines, each pigment of data tagged, and a glacier of verification stands behind every step. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because forging an identity requires producing authenticated shares that pass the codes, and a single bad share exposes the whole attempt.
